notes.title: Demo Update #2 (202440916.16.38.WD)
notes.content:
This update fixes:

- The Proto vehicle is now available for free from the start of the game. If you're having trouble starting with the Jeep Willys, the Proto will help you progress through levels more easily.

- The Omaha Beach level has been made easier. Enemy fire now causes less damage.

notes.title: Demo Update #1 (202440911.19.8.WD)
notes.content:
This update fixes:

[list]
[*] The leaderboards now display 15 scores, and the ranking order has been corrected in case of tied scores.
[*] The replay button now allows players to instantly replay a game if they have enough credits; otherwise, they are returned to the menu.
[*] The wind in the "D-Day" level has been reduced by 50% to make jumps between two barges easier.
[/list]

tags.feature: The replay button now allows players to instantly replay a game if they have enough credits; otherwise, they are returned to the menu.
